pages.title: A Door Through the Gap
pages.text: A two-block-tall portal that sends anything walking into it to its paired portal. Place the first portal and you will receive a linked portal item for the other side.

Use the linked portal item on the placed portal to finish the connection. A portal in the Overworld creates its partner in the Gap at matching coordinates, with height adjusted for the other side; a portal in the Gap can likewise create a way back. The destination prepares an obsidian landing pad, so leave a clear space at least 3×2×3 blocks large.$(br2)Walk into either portal to travel between them. Right-click a placed portal with an empty hand to pick it up and break the link, or break its bottom half. Using a paired portal item on an already completed pair moves the matching portal to a new location.
